pages.title: As condições da cidade
pages.layout: Eda LEFT reads three signed conditions at an archive table; Ilyan RIGHT writes them down. Medium two-shot, faces around y38 percent, clear wall above.
pages.scene: Eda LEFT reads three signed conditions at an archive table; Ilyan RIGHT writes them down. Medium two-shot, faces around y38 percent, clear wall above.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: A régua permanece na oficina.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Vou registrar as condições.

pages.title: Uma recusa legítima
pages.layout: Ilyan alone in close medium profile at archive window, holding the refusal letter below his chest; reflective, no anger. Face around x60 y40, free shelving at upper left.
pages.scene: Ilyan alone in close medium profile at archive window, holding the refusal letter below his chest; reflective, no anger. Face around x60 y40, free shelving at upper left.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Uma marca de Mira não vale mais que a cidade.

pages.title: Só o trajeto público
pages.layout: Overhead still-life: a school route map, outer stair drawing, twine boundary and closed wax-sealed envelope. A route stops outside a heavily hatched lower passage. No people, no hands, no text.
pages.scene: Overhead still-life: a school route map, outer stair drawing, twine boundary and closed wax-sealed envelope. A route stops outside a heavily hatched lower passage. No people, no hands, no text.
pages.narration: A autorização alcançava as plantas externas. O selo inferior continuava fechado.

pages.title: Água contada
pages.layout: Runa alone packing THREE small glass water flasks into a cloth-lined satchel on archive table, not casting magic. Three-quarter portrait with her LEFT floral arm visible; head around x50 y36, empty upper shelves.
pages.scene: Runa alone packing THREE small glass water flasks into a cloth-lined satchel on archive table, not casting magic. Three-quarter portrait with her LEFT floral arm visible; head around x50 y36, empty upper shelves.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Levo só o necessário para cada teste.

pages.title: Quatro respirações
pages.layout: School courtyard: Caio LEFT controls existing breeze aligning three ribbons between columns; Sere RIGHT observes with notebook. Medium-wide single frame; both faces around y37, hands below them; no other figures.
pages.scene: School courtyard: Caio LEFT controls existing breeze aligning three ribbons between columns; Sere RIGHT observes with notebook. Medium-wide single frame; both faces around y37, hands below them; no other figures.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Uma... duas... três... quatro.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Agora pare e observe.

pages.title: O nó cede
pages.layout: Close medium Caio alone stopping his wind gesture as one loose ribbon flutters safely sideways; concerned but controlled, one head at x50 y37, exactly two arms, no glowing tornado.
pages.scene: Close medium Caio alone stopping his wind gesture as one loose ribbon flutters safely sideways; concerned but controlled, one head at x50 y37, exactly two arms, no glowing tornado.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Parei. Não vou corrigir com outra rajada.

pages.title: O ombro avisa
pages.layout: Tovo alone in forge training bay beside a tool chest on wooden rollers; he stops pushing and rests a hand against his sore shoulder with a restrained wince. No broken bones or magic glow. One tall broad body; head x50 y35; chest and rollers visible.
pages.scene: Tovo alone in forge training bay beside a tool chest on wooden rollers; he stops pushing and rests a hand against his sore shoulder with a restrained wince. No broken bones or magic glow. One tall broad body; head x50 y35; chest and rollers visible.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Mais força não fez meu ombro doer menos.

pages.title: A talha
pages.layout: Teren LEFT demonstrates a securely overhead-mounted rope pulley; Tovo RIGHT uses the free rope to move the tool chest slowly along rollers. Chest remains on floor, consistent functional ropes. Two distinct bodies, heads y33, clear upper brick strip for balloons.
pages.scene: Teren LEFT demonstrates a securely overhead-mounted rope pulley; Tovo RIGHT uses the free rope to move the tool chest slowly along rollers. Chest remains on floor, consistent functional ropes. Two distinct bodies, heads y33, clear upper brick strip for balloons.

lines.speaker: Teren
lines.text: Deixe a talha dividir o peso.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Assim eu termino sem piorar o ombro.

pages.title: Autoria não é acordo
pages.layout: Liria alone leaning over her own stone-fracture diagram at separate archive desk, fierce concentration, exactly TWO long tight brown braids, grey coat red seams, short chin scar. Face x50 y38. No Runa.
pages.scene: Liria alone leaning over her own stone-fracture diagram at separate archive desk, fierce concentration, exactly TWO long tight brown braids, grey coat red seams, short chin scar. Face x50 y38. No Runa.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Anexe minha leitura da junta inferior.

pages.narration: Líria ficaria na Casa e prepararia sua análise separadamente.

pages.title: O limite permanece
pages.layout: Eda LEFT quietly checks Runa RIGHT packing satchel in archive room, respectful distance. Runa tense, holding small water flask low; her LEFT floral tattoo visible. Both heads y39; no Liria or reconciliation.
pages.scene: Eda LEFT quietly checks Runa RIGHT packing satchel in archive room, respectful distance. Runa tense, holding small water flask low; her LEFT floral tattoo visible. Both heads y39; no Liria or reconciliation.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Outra análise pode entrar no relatório. Outra agressão, não.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Eu sei. O limite continua claro.

pages.title: Fora da avaliação
pages.layout: Tender fully clothed adult couple Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT sitting close on courtyard bench at night, gently touching foreheads, relaxed. Same heights (Sere slightly taller), no kiss covering faces, hands resting separately. Faces y43, moonlit wall free above.
pages.scene: Tender fully clothed adult couple Caio LEFT and Sere RIGHT sitting close on courtyard bench at night, gently touching foreheads, relaxed. Same heights (Sere slightly taller), no kiss covering faces, hands resting separately. Faces y43, moonlit wall free above.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Prefiro ouvir isso fora de uma avaliação.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Não preciso de você perfeito para querer ficar.

pages.title: A carta chega a Pedra-Mansa
pages.layout: Nima alone on an adult-appropriate LOW stool at a low forge worktable in Pedra-Mansa, reading Ilyan letter, curly copper bob, freckles, pointed ears, moss cap with brass goggles and teal vest. Scale about 90cm relative to normal-height bench behind. Head x50 y36. No Ilyan present.
pages.scene: Nima alone on an adult-appropriate LOW stool at a low forge worktable in Pedra-Mansa, reading Ilyan letter, curly copper bob, freckles, pointed ears, moss cap with brass goggles and teal vest. Scale about 90cm relative to normal-height bench behind. Head x50 y36. No Ilyan present.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Essa marca lembra um contrapeso antigo.

pages.title: O que ela quer construir
pages.layout: Bram LEFT adult broad human blacksmith with tied dark hair grey temples and short grey beard, cream shirt and dark apron, leans at forge workbench; adult gnome Nima RIGHT sits on a raised work stool so faces near same picture level, her body still half human height. He listens, she points to mechanism sketch below. ONLY Bram from first reference, NOT Ilyan. Faces y38, space above.
pages.scene: Bram LEFT adult broad human blacksmith with tied dark hair grey temples and short grey beard, cream shirt and dark apron, leans at forge workbench; adult gnome Nima RIGHT sits on a raised work stool so faces near same picture level, her body still half human height. He listens, she points to mechanism sketch below. ONLY Bram from first reference, NOT Ilyan. Faces y38, space above.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: O que você quer construir em Talveira?

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Algo que a artesã consiga consertar sem mim.

pages.title: Uma contratação própria
pages.layout: Macro still-life on a forge desk: two separately sealed letters, a contract with blank illegible ruled lines, hinge drawing, small brass measuring caliper and rolled tool list. No people or limbs; warm light.
pages.scene: Macro still-life on a forge desk: two separately sealed letters, a contract with blank illegible ruled lines, hinge drawing, small brass measuring caliper and rolled tool list. No people or limbs; warm light.
pages.narration: O convite da artesã vinha de uma recomendação de Beren. Nima viajaria por trabalho.

pages.title: Lentes bem guardadas
pages.layout: Nima alone at low workshop bench carefully wraps two brass lenses in padded cloth, focused adult face. Correct small adult gnome proportions, goggles on moss cap, tool belt; fingers distinct and two hands. Face y35, clear upper forge beams.
pages.scene: Nima alone at low workshop bench carefully wraps two brass lenses in padded cloth, focused adult face. Correct small adult gnome proportions, goggles on moss cap, tool belt; fingers distinct and two hands. Face y35, clear upper forge beams.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Desenhos, acompanhante local e direito de parar.

pages.title: Duas respostas
pages.layout: Nima alone at low writing desk in forge folds two different letters, one sealed near edge, one in her hands. Mature gnome face copper curls, teal waistcoat, cream sleeves, no extra people; face y35, airy top background.
pages.scene: Nima alone at low writing desk in forge folds two different letters, one sealed near edge, one in her hands. Mature gnome face copper curls, teal waistcoat, cream sleeves, no extra people; face y35, airy top background.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Para a artesã, as condições. Para Ilyan, uma conversa.

pages.title: O peso da mala
pages.layout: Full three-quarter Nima alone packing a compact leather tool case on low bench; heavier brass test cylinders remain clearly on forge shelf behind. Her moss cap/goggles on head, petite adult 90cm body, no oversized adult-human stature. Face y34; warm night lantern.
pages.scene: Full three-quarter Nima alone packing a compact leather tool case on low bench; heavier brass test cylinders remain clearly on forge shelf behind. Her moss cap/goggles on head, petite adult 90cm body, no oversized adult-human stature. Face y34; warm night lantern.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Os cilindros pesados ficam. Posso montá-los lá.

pages.title: A forja ao anoitecer
pages.layout: Wide atmospheric exterior of Pedra-Mansa forge at blue hour, warm furnace seen through door, ordinary road leading away; one packed compact case near door, no people, no readable signs, no magic portal.
pages.scene: Wide atmospheric exterior of Pedra-Mansa forge at blue hour, warm furnace seen through door, ordinary road leading away; one packed compact case near door, no people, no readable signs, no magic portal.
pages.narration: A partida seria pela estrada comum, com comida, ferramentas e dias de viagem.

pages.title: Licenças no tubo
pages.layout: Ilyan alone at archive counter tucks signed travel papers into a dry leather document tube, provisions and boundary rope on table. His long wavy black center-parted hair, narrow youthful clean-shaven face, indigo vest. Face y36; no literal glass ruler.
pages.scene: Ilyan alone at archive counter tucks signed travel papers into a dry leather document tube, provisions and boundary rope on table. His long wavy black center-parted hair, narrow youthful clean-shaven face, indigo vest. Face y36; no literal glass ruler.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A rota de volta também está registrada.

pages.title: À espera da maré
pages.layout: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT stand safely at ferry landing waiting beside rope barrier, normal adult heights, travel satchels and dry tube. Boat moored farther behind, river tide visibly low. Three-quarter two shot with heads y38, open awning/sky above. No other close figures.
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT stand safely at ferry landing waiting beside rope barrier, normal adult heights, travel satchels and dry tube. Boat moored farther behind, river tide visibly low. Three-quarter two shot with heads y38, open awning/sky above. No other close figures.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A maré ainda não permite cruzar.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Então esperamos.

pages.title: Outra estrada
pages.layout: Nima alone seated safely on a low padded crate inside a merchant cart, her compact tool case secured beside her. Petite adult gnome, copper curly bob, moss cap brass goggles, teal vest. Framing through wagon opening, road toward countryside, other traders not visible. Head x50 y40.
pages.scene: Nima alone seated safely on a low padded crate inside a merchant cart, her compact tool case secured beside her. Petite adult gnome, copper curly bob, moss cap brass goggles, teal vest. Framing through wagon opening, road toward countryside, other traders not visible. Head x50 y40.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Primeiro a Casa. Depois a travessia autorizada.

pages.title: Uma cadeira de cliente
pages.layout: Nima alone at inn counter, adult gnome standing on floor beside an absurdly tall human chair and a proper low sturdy chair she indicates. Serious self-possessed mature face, no childish pout, exact copper bob and cap. Full body visible, sensible height comparison; no innkeeper face.
pages.scene: Nima alone at inn counter, adult gnome standing on floor beside an absurdly tall human chair and a proper low sturdy chair she indicates. Serious self-possessed mature face, no childish pout, exact copper bob and cap. Full body visible, sensible height comparison; no innkeeper face.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Sou uma cliente adulta. Preciso de uma cadeira adequada.

pages.title: A margem oeste
pages.layout: Wide riverside inn at night on west ferry bank, tethered empty boat, lit windows, quiet river and untraveled far shore. No people or readable signs, complete medieval hand-painted scene.
pages.scene: Wide riverside inn at night on west ferry bank, tethered empty boat, lit windows, quiet river and untraveled far shore. No people or readable signs, complete medieval hand-painted scene.
pages.narration: A equipe pagou a passagem e dormiu na pousada da margem oeste.

pages.title: Nomes, prazo e retorno
pages.layout: Ysra LEFT at woodland guardian checkpoint verifies Ilyan RIGHT dry permit tube and paper; bark-fiber dark hair and small temple twigs, fully golden eyes, dark earth skin, moss robes. Ilyan matches exact reference. Two figures, faces y37, carved trees/green light above. No portal.
pages.scene: Ysra LEFT at woodland guardian checkpoint verifies Ilyan RIGHT dry permit tube and paper; bark-fiber dark hair and small temple twigs, fully golden eyes, dark earth skin, moss robes. Ilyan matches exact reference. Two figures, faces y37, carved trees/green light above. No portal.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Nomes, prazo e caminho de volta.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Tudo está nas licenças.

pages.title: Talveira volta a abrir
pages.layout: New wide establishing view of canonical Talveira from street level: blue glass-roofed bridge between gothic stone canal towers, stone quay and golden lamps, tiny anonymous distant passersby only for scale, no identifiable heroes, complete architecture no cut-sky collage.
pages.scene: New wide establishing view of canonical Talveira from street level: blue glass-roofed bridge between gothic stone canal towers, stone quay and golden lamps, tiny anonymous distant passersby only for scale, no identifiable heroes, complete architecture no cut-sky collage.
pages.narration: A ponte estava aberta sob controle. A cidade recebia visitantes, não donos.

pages.title: O pino da roda
pages.layout: Nima kneels safely beside stationary merchant wagon wheel supported by chocks, replaces missing retaining pin with temporary copper wire. Three-quarter side view, anatomically correct two hands, body outside wheel, no moving wagon. Face x45 y36, wagon frame background, tool case open below.
pages.scene: Nima kneels safely beside stationary merchant wagon wheel supported by chocks, replaces missing retaining pin with temporary copper wire. Three-quarter side view, anatomically correct two hands, body outside wheel, no moving wagon. Face x45 y36, wagon frame background, tool case open below.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Até a próxima vila. Depois, troquem por um pino novo.

pages.title: O desvio pelo vau
pages.layout: Wide landscape showing a closed rain-damaged bridge in background and a shallow safe ford farther upstream with a merchant wagon stopped on bank and half-unloaded crates. No close people, no magic, warm afternoon and practical muddy road.
pages.scene: Wide landscape showing a closed rain-damaged bridge in background and a shallow safe ford farther upstream with a merchant wagon stopped on bank and half-unloaded crates. No close people, no magic, warm afternoon and practical muddy road.
pages.narration: No terceiro dia, descarregaram metade da carroça antes de seguir pelo vau.

pages.title: Medir duas vezes
pages.layout: Nima alone examines an old brass hinge at village market stall, measuring it with small calipers, paying coins visible on table. Adult short gnome stands on ground at low end of counter, waist not stretched, curly copper bob, moss cap goggles, teal vest. Head x50 y36; merchant not visible.
pages.scene: Nima alone examines an old brass hinge at village market stall, measuring it with small calipers, paying coins visible on table. Adult short gnome stands on ground at low end of counter, waist not stretched, curly copper bob, moss cap goggles, teal vest. Head x50 y36; merchant not visible.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: A maioria dos consertos começa medindo duas vezes.

pages.title: A Casa já estava vazia
pages.layout: Ordelia LEFT stands at archive counter and hands a letter to Nima RIGHT, adult gnome on a properly low visitor stool, her head lower than Ordelia by natural 90cm vs human scale. Side by side not child. One iron-grey braid wine robe versus copper bob/moss cap teal vest. Upper wall clear, no Ilyan.
pages.scene: Ordelia LEFT stands at archive counter and hands a letter to Nima RIGHT, adult gnome on a properly low visitor stool, her head lower than Ordelia by natural 90cm vs human scale. Side by side not child. One iron-grey braid wine robe versus copper bob/moss cap teal vest. Upper wall clear, no Ilyan.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Eles já estão em Talveira.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Runa deixou uma carta para mim?

pages.title: Uma conversa antes do abraço
pages.layout: Nima alone sitting by school guestroom window reads two letters privately, touched and teary without exaggerated sobbing. Copper curls, freckles, adult gnome, moss cap with goggles placed on small table, teal vest cream blouse retained. Head x50 y38, night sky upper background.
pages.scene: Nima alone sitting by school guestroom window reads two letters privately, touched and teary without exaggerated sobbing. Copper curls, freckles, adult gnome, moss cap with goggles placed on small table, teal vest cream blouse retained. Head x50 y38, night sky upper background.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: Também prefiro uma conversa difícil a uma surpresa.

pages.narration: Runa escrevera antes da partida. Ilyan respondera de Talveira e oferecera a rota autorizada.

pages.title: A barca regular
pages.layout: Nima alone seated safely inside regular river ferry cabin beside her shut tool case, moss cap brass goggles back on, exact adult small gnome proportions. Looking through window at willow bank, no magical shortcut or heroic flying craft. Face x50 y38; cabin upper wall clear.
pages.scene: Nima alone seated safely inside regular river ferry cabin beside her shut tool case, moss cap brass goggles back on, exact adult small gnome proportions. Looking through window at willow bank, no magical shortcut or heroic flying craft. Face x50 y38; cabin upper wall clear.

lines.speaker: Nima
lines.text: O horário é da barca. Não da minha pressa.

pages.narration: Ordelia organizou a passagem comum. Nima percorreu a estrada e esperou os guardiões.

pages.title: Chegar por inteiro
pages.layout: Talveira workshop doorway and canal square: Nima LEFT (90cm tall adult gnome, exact copper curly bob, moss cap goggles, teal vest cream blouse toolbelt) exits having finished her contracted conversation offscreen; Ilyan RIGHT (175cm adult human canonical long wavy black hair clean-shaven indigo vest) waits a few steps away at respectful distance with relieved smile. Show FULL bodies and clear natural height contrast: Nima head about Ilyan waist, no raised platform, no toddler proportions, no hug yet. Reserve unobstructed sky/stone for lettering. No Runa or other close people.
pages.scene: Talveira workshop doorway and canal square: Nima LEFT (90cm tall adult gnome, exact copper curly bob, moss cap goggles, teal vest cream blouse toolbelt) exits having finished her contracted conversation offscreen; Ilyan RIGHT (175cm adult human canonical long wavy black hair clean-shaven indigo vest) waits a few steps away at respectful distance with relieved smile. Show FULL bodies and clear natural height contrast: Nima head about Ilyan waist, no raised platform, no toddler proportions, no hug yet. Reserve unobstructed sky/stone for lettering. No Runa or other close people.
pages.narration: Nima concluiu primeiro a conversa com a artesã. Ilyan a esperava na praça, sem exigir que a chegada respondesse a tudo.
